## About
Hynes Auto Service is a family owned shop in Glenview, serving the people of the North Shore and the surrounding areas. Our ASE professional technicians handle major and minor repairs on foreign and domestic vehicles, and we look after every car like it was our own.
We're a certified NAPA AutoCare Center, so you get the backing of a national network along with the personal attention of a family business. Neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating across 303 Google reviews, and many mention the same thing: friendly people and honest work.

## Services
- Oil change: We change your oil and check for any potential problems while your car is with us.
- Brake repair: Hearing squeaking or grinding? Our team is equipped to repair all brake systems.
- Transmission and suspension repair: Beyond routine work, we take on bigger jobs like transmission and suspension repair.
- Tire pressure monitoring: We service the tire pressure monitoring systems found on newer cars and light trucks.
- Exhaust: Customers bring their cars to us to have the exhaust replaced.

## FAQ
Q: Can you give me a ride while my car is in the shop?
A: Just ask. We're happy to pick you up or drop you off at home, the train station or your office.

Q: What if I can't make it before you close?
A: We have a 24/7 box where you can pick up your keys after hours.

Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. Our technicians handle major and minor repairs on both foreign and domestic vehicles.

Q: Is your work covered by a warranty?
A: We offer the NAPA AutoCare Peace of Mind Warranty, which covers parts and labor on qualifying repairs and services for 24 months/24,000 miles.
